target.title: fix #99174: classify structured invalid request failover
target.body:
## Summary
- classify structured API error payloads with `invalid_request*` types as `format` failover errors when no leading HTTP status is present
- preserve existing higher-priority classifications for context overflow, auth, and billing messages inside the same structured payload shape
- add regression coverage for Anthropic-shaped unprefixed `invalid_request_error` bodies

Fixes #99174.

## Tests
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers.isbillingerrormessage.test.ts --reporter=verbose` (146 passed)
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-agents.tsbuildinfo`
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers/errors.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers.isbillingerrormessage.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers/errors.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers.isbillingerrormessage.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Note: the normal `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs ...` wrapper was attempted twice, but `prepare-extension-package-boundary-artifacts` timed out while preparing plugin-sdk boundary root shims before file linting started. The direct file oxlint run with `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1` passed.
